dedupe_keys.name: thetis mrv eu shipping co2 emissions reports

description: THETIS-MRV is the information system run by the European Maritime Safety Agency to implement Regulation (EU) 2015/757 on the monitoring, reporting and verification of carbon dioxide emissions from maritime transport. Companies report, and accredited verifiers confirm, the CO2 emitted by large ships of more than 5,000 gross tonnage calling at EU and EEA ports, underway and at berth, with related information such as energy efficiency, distance travelled, time at sea and cargo carried. The system issues documents of compliance and lets flag states consult the reports; the emission reports are publicly available per ship and year through the THETIS-MRV portal, and the European Commission publishes an annual report on the monitored fleet. EMSA notes that maritime transport produces 13.5 percent of transport greenhouse gas emissions in the EU. Coverage: the EU and EEA port calls of large ships, annual reporting periods since 2018. Access: free public portal (a JavaScript web application) with downloadable tables. Licence and cost: free, under EMSA's legal notice with no open licence stated. Caveats: self-reported values checked by verifiers, only ships above 5,000 GT, annual aggregates per ship without voyage detail. It supports emission and energy scenarios for shipping and port traffic models. It relates to UNCTADstat maritime transport data in the catalogue.
